title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Score Vinyl Is Up for Preorder (Not to Be Confused with GTA 6: The Album)
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Score is a three-hour compilation of new music from Justice, and it's available to preorder now on CD and vinyl.

By Chris Reed Updated : Oct 30, 2026 7:15pm UTC 0 comments Add IGN on Google Grand Theft Auto: The Original Score is now available for preorder in vinyl and CD format . It’s by the Grammy Award-winning French electronic duo Justice, and it contains 30 tracks, including the songs “ Flower in a Hurricane ” and “ Pusher ." The album is set to release December 11 , which is nearly a month after GTA 6 the game comes out. Here’s everything you need to know to preorder it. Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score - Vinyl (3 LP) Out December 11 Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice - Vinyl (3 LP) 0 $45.99 at Amazon Get it at Amazon Get it at Justice (Clear Vinyl Limited Edition) The vinyl edition comes in a 3LP set with UV gloss finish. Amazon has black vinyl, while Justice's storefront has it in a limited-edition clear vinyl. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Soundtrack - CD Out December 11 Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Soundtrack - CD (2 Discs) 0 $19.98 at Amazon Get it at Amazon - $19.98 Get it at Justice - $19.00 The CD version comes on two discs, in an intricate fold-out case featuring GTA 6 imagery. GTA 6: The Original Score vs. GTA 6: The Album Grand Theft Auto VI: The Original Score is a three-hour compilation of music primarily by Justice. It's not to be confused with Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , which features original songs by a variety of musicians. Whichever format you choose, the album includes 30 songs, plus “a number of digital bonus tracks.” In total, the score includes three hours’ worth of material from the game. So far, only two tracks from this album have been released. The first is “Flower in a Hurricane,” by Justice, featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard, which is the song featured the launch trailer . The other song is “Pusher,” by Justice featuring the French DJ and record producer Gesaffelstein. And although it only features 30 official songs, the bonus material appears to push the track listing to 50 songs, judging by the album's listing on Apple Music. Where to Stream It Speaking of streamers, if you’d rather stream the album when it’s out on December 11, you can pre-add it on your streaming service of choice below. Apple Spotify Amazon Music YouTube Music Tidal Deezer Grand Theft Auto VI is set to release November 19. It's available widely for preorder right now. If you do preorder it in any format, you'll be able to pre-load the game on your PS5 or Xbox Series X|S starting on November 12.
